title: Here’s everything we learned about AirPods with cameras this week
summary: In the video, the AirPods Pro with cameras look nearly identical to the existing AirPods Pro 3. According to code viewed by 9to5Mac , Apple will use a new AccessorySensorMgrd framework to control image capture and other aspects of AirPods with cameras.
